name: Swords
overview: The Bible presents swords both as instruments of war and symbols of spiritual truth. While Nehemiah 4:17 and Psalms 144:1 acknowledge the practical and God-given strength for physical battle, Isaiah 2:4 envisions a future where swords are transformed into tools of peace. Jesus’ teachings in Matthew 10:34, 26:52, and Luke 22:36 reveal the tension between the reality of conflict and the call to trust God rather than violence, warning that those who live by the sword will also perish by it.
